packageRules.description: nextcloud/ocp has to match the minimum supported Nextcloud version (min-version in appinfo/info.xml).
The test instances are the supported version matrix; a new Nextcloud version is added deliberately (dev/compose.yaml, playwright.config.ts, max-version).

Nextcloud's build config @nextcloud/vite-config decides which vite major works: 2.x only accepts vite 7 as a peer dependency, vite 8 needs @nextcloud/vite-config 3. Raise this limit only together with @nextcloud/vite-config.
Major updates of vite and @nextcloud/vite-config come in one PR, so the switch to a new vite major happens in a single update.
